title: Reliable Messaging: Idempotency, Retries, Dead Letters and the Outbox
summary: Design for at-least-once delivery with idempotent consumers and an inbox table, separate transient from poison failures, configure dead-letter queues, publish through a transactional outbox, and weigh MassTransit's commercial licence.

resources.label: Transactional Outbox pattern with Azure Cosmos DB (Azure Architecture Center; the overview applies to EF Core)
